```yaml
name: Nuitka Linux Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install nuitka

      - name: Build with Nuitka
        run: |
          # Build a standalone one‑file binary
          nuitka --standalone --onefile dirsearch.py
          # On Unix the output is a plain executable named after the script
          # Rename it to a consistent name for artifact upload
          mv dirsearch dirsearch-linux

      - name: Upload binary artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dirsearch-linux
          path: dirsearch-linux
```
